div.div: مَصَابٌ [A place of pouring forth: pl. مَصَاوِبُ]. One says, هُوَ مَصَابُ الوَدْقِ [It is the place of the pouring of rain in the clouds]: and شِمْتُ مَصَاوِبَ المَطَرِ [I watched, or watched for, the places of the pouring of rain in the clouds]: and سَقَاهُمْ مَصَاوِبُ السَّمَآءَ [The places of the pouring of the rain watered them; or may the places &c. water them]. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
